title: The Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals
field: Master's studies at Swedish universities (eligible programmes)
about: Swedish Institute scholarships for global professionals to study eligible master's programmes in Sweden in 2027/28. Apply to the programme via UniversityAdmissions.se by 15 January 2027, then to SI between 8 and 24 February 2027 (14:59 CET). Results 22 April 2027.
requirements: Apply to an eligible master's programme via UniversityAdmissions.se by 15 January 2027
Must be admitted to an eligible programme by 1 April 2027
Applicants from certain listed countries need at least 3,000 hours of work experience
Scholarship portal open 8-24 February 2027; late applications not accepted
card_alt: Card for The Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals from the Swedish Institute (Svenska institutet), for master's study in Sweden, deadline 24 Feb 2027. The photo shows an aerial view of Stockholm's Gamla stan and Riddarholmen, with the spire of Riddarholmen Church, colourful old-town buildings and the waterfront.
